verdict.rationale: Offering downloadable forms and instructions without an account is a fair question for a state business-filing agency, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes showing crawling was disallowed and never performed. Nothing shows whether forms or instructions can be downloaded without an account, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
